title: fix: add missing frontmatter to docs breaking CI build
body:
CI "Build Docs" job fails — `fumadocs-mdx` rejects 7 markdown files missing required `title` frontmatter.

```
Error: [MDX] invalid frontmatter in content/docs/PLUGIN_ECOSYSTEM_MAP.md:
- title: Invalid input: expected string, received undefined
```

Added YAML frontmatter to all 7 files:

- `content/docs/PLUGIN_ECOSYSTEM_MAP.md`
- `content/docs/PLUGIN_MARKETPLACE_DESIGN.md`
- `content/docs/analysis/02-data-protocol-impact.md`
- `content/docs/analysis/04-api-protocol-impact.md`
- `content/docs/analysis/07-auth-protocol-impact.md`
- `content/docs/analysis/08-integration-protocol-impact.md`
- `content/docs/analysis/10-permission-protocol-impact.md`

Example of the fix applied to each file:

```md
---
title: Plugin Ecosystem Map
description: ObjectStack plugin ecosystem architecture and integration map
---

# ObjectStack Plugin Ecosystem Map
```
